body: This one-page plan tells staff what to do in the first hour of a suspected card-data incident.
Post it where shift leads can reach it. Review it at least once per year.
sections.heading: Purpose and scope

body: Call the processor and acquirer contact numbers listed below. Do not turn off or wipe an affected terminal or computer until the processor or investigator advises, so evidence is preserved.
Limit access to the affected area to the owner and one named staff member.
sections.heading: First-hour steps

body: Write down the time the issue was noticed, who noticed it, which device or area is affected, and what was observed.
Keep this note with the incident file. Add follow-up entries with dates.
sections.heading: What to record

body: no compliance guarantees; your acquirer/bank decides what is required. This template does not promise any SAQ outcome.
sections.heading: Review and disclosure

body: List every outside company that touches card payments for you: processor, terminal supplier, website host, email provider if receipts go by email, and any IT support firm.
Ask each provider for a current responsibility statement or compliance document and file it.
sections.heading: How to use this list

body: Copy this block once per provider. Keep the newest document for each provider in one folder.
sections.heading: Provider record

body: Mark providers with missing documents as gaps in the readiness log. Follow up on the next review date.
sections.heading: Gaps and follow-up
